title: Sorted panel with exact parquet dtypes
source:
import os
import pandas as pd
raw = pd.read_csv("/input/environment/data/raw.csv", dtype={"asset": str})
panel = pd.DataFrame({
    "date": pd.to_datetime(raw["date"]).astype("datetime64[ns]"),
    "asset": raw["asset"].astype(object),
    "score": raw["score"].astype("float64"),
}).sort_values(["date", "asset"], kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
panel.to_parquet("/app/output/panel.parquet", index=False)
